verdict.rationale: Ramp documents AI-driven auto-coding of transactions to GL/accounting categories synced to ERPs (ramp-docs-15, ramp-docs-17, ramp-supp-ramp-agents-product) plus explicit multi-entity support with consolidated reporting (ramp-docs-14) and real-time ERP sync eliminating manual journal entries (ramp-docs-5), directly supporting AI-assisted GL coding to accelerate close across entities. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence quantifying close-time acceleration or GL-coding accuracy specifically across multiple entities, and no third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
